title: Al-Mubdiʾ al-Muʿīd — The Originator and Restorer

blocks.text: The meaning of **al-Mubdiʾ al-Muʿīd** is the one who brings (another) into being, but when this bringing into being has no precedent in terms of an act similar to it, it is called an origination. If there is a precedent in terms of an act similar to it, it is called a restoration. God Most High began the creation of people. Then He is (also) the one who restores them; that is to say, He resurrects them. All things first originated from Him and are restored to Him, and by Him all things are originated and by Him they are restored.
112 This concept is used in respect of God only in verbal form. S. 58, 6/7 (B-16); 72, 28 (A-2-15); *inter alia.*
113 Both concepts are found in verbal form in respect of God in S. 85, 13 (A-1-44).
